## Pilot study in area B

We first looked at a 4 km by 4 km area near Coimbra, Portugal. The yellow line on the first map shows the main road we selected.

```{r}
#| message: false
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyterra)

photo_2018 <- rast("Raw Data/dgt_ortho2018_context.tif")
photo_2025 <- rast("Raw Data/dgt_ortho2025_context.tif")
land_cover <- read_sf("Raw Data/cos2018_land_cover.geojson")
forest_2018 <- read_sf("Raw Data/cos2018_eucalyptus.geojson")
forest_2025 <- read_sf("Raw Data/cos2025_eucalyptus.geojson")
road <- read_sf("Raw Data/cos2018_roads.geojson") %>%
  filter(ogc_fid == 147070)

# Crop the climate data to the pilot area.
area <- as.polygons(ext(photo_2018), crs = crs(photo_2018))
window <- project(area, "EPSG:4326")
climate_file <- "Raw Data/PRT_wc2.1_30s_bio.tif"
climate_url <- paste0(
  "https://geodata.ucdavis.edu/climate/worldclim/2_1/tiles/iso/",
  "PRT_wc2.1_30s_bio.tif")
if (!file.exists(climate_file)) {
  download.file(climate_url, climate_file, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
}
climate <- rast(climate_file)[[c(1, 12)]] %>%
  crop(window, snap = "out")
names(climate) <- c("temperature", "precipitation")
```

Four fields from the 2018 land-cover map are shown below.

```{r}
land_cover %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(id = ogc_fid, cover_code = cos18v4_n4_c, cover_name = cos18v4_n4_l, area_ha) %>%
  glimpse(width = 68)
```

```{r}
draw_map <- function(photo, layer, title) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_spatraster_rgb(data = photo, interpolate = FALSE,
                        maxcell = ncell(photo)) +
    layer +
    coord_sf(crs = 3763, datum = st_crs(3763), expand = FALSE,
             xlim = c(xmin(photo), xmax(photo)),
             ylim = c(ymin(photo), ymax(photo))) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Easting (m)", y = "Northing (m)") +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

```{r}
#| out-width: 5.2in
#| fig-align: center
draw_map(photo_2018,
         geom_sf(data = road, fill = "#FFD166", colour = NA),
         "Selected main road, 2018")
```


## Regional eucalyptus forest cover

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
input <- function(name) file.path("Raw Data", name)
study_area <- st_read(input("land_cover.gpkg"), "study_area", quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_geometry()
```

```{r}
#| label: prepare-forest-maps
#| include: false
forest_in_region <- function(year) {
  forest <- st_read(input("land_cover.gpkg"), layer = paste0("euc", year), quiet = TRUE)
  inside <- st_intersection(st_geometry(forest), st_geometry(study_area))
  st_union(inside[st_dimension(inside) == 2])
}

forest18 <- forest_in_region(2018)
forest25 <- forest_in_region(2025)
changes <- st_sf(
  cover = c("Retained", "Gained", "Lost"),
  geometry = c(st_intersection(forest18, forest25),
               st_difference(forest25, forest18),
               st_difference(forest18, forest25))
)
areas_ha <- function(x) as.numeric(st_area(x)) / 10000
forest_area_ha <- c("2018" = areas_ha(forest18), "2025" = areas_ha(forest25),
                    setNames(areas_ha(changes), c("Retained", "Gain", "Loss")))
hectares <- function(x) paste0(format(round(x), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE), " ha")

map_forest <- function(features, colours, heading, detail) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = study_area, aes(fill = "Other cover"), colour = NA) +
    geom_sf(data = features, aes(fill = cover), colour = NA) +
    geom_sf(data = study_area, fill = NA, colour = "grey48", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_manual(NULL, values = colours, breaks = names(colours)) +
    coord_sf(datum = st_crs(4326), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(title = heading, subtitle = detail, x = NULL, y = NULL,
         caption = "Central Portugal  |  North up  |  Map width about 34 km") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.key = element_rect(colour = "grey78", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.2),
          plot.title.position = "plot", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),
          plot.caption.position = "plot", plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0))
}

annual_colours <- c("Eucalyptus forest" = "#286850", "Other cover" = "#F7F6F1")
annual_map <- function(forest, year) {
  features <- st_sf(cover = "Eucalyptus forest", geometry = forest)
  map_forest(features, annual_colours, paste("Eucalyptus forest in", year),
             paste("Mapped forest area:", hectares(forest_area_ha[year])))
}
change_detail <- paste("Gained", hectares(forest_area_ha["Gain"]), " |  Lost",
                       hectares(forest_area_ha["Loss"]), " |  Retained",
                       hectares(forest_area_ha["Retained"]))
maps <- list(
  "2018" = annual_map(forest18, "2018"),
  "2025" = annual_map(forest25, "2025"),
  "change" = map_forest(changes,
    c("Gained" = "#006792", "Lost" = "#BF430D", "Retained" = "#CED9CC",
      "Other cover" = "#F7F6F1"),
    "Eucalyptus forest change, 2018 to 2025", change_detail)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: forest-2018
#| echo: false
#| dev: pdf
#| fig-width: 6.6
#| fig-height: 6.9
maps[["2018"]]
```

Green shows forest mapped as mainly eucalyptus in 2018. The study area is near Coimbra in central Portugal (8.50–8.10°W, 40.025–40.325°N).

## Environment table

```{r}
#| label: environmental-locations
#| include: false
bounds <- st_bbox(study_area)
centres <- function(lo, hi) seq(floor(lo / 80) * 80 + 40, hi, by = 80)
sites <- expand.grid(x_m = centres(bounds["xmin"], bounds["xmax"]),
                     y_m = centres(bounds["ymin"], bounds["ymax"])) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x_m", "y_m"), crs = 3763, remove = FALSE)
sites <- sites[lengths(st_within(sites, study_area)) > 0, ]

land18 <- st_read(input("land_cover.gpkg"), "land2018", quiet = TRUE)
hit <- st_intersects(sites, land18)
land_row <- rep(NA_integer_, nrow(sites))
unique_hit <- lengths(hit) == 1L
land_row[unique_hit] <- unlist(hit[unique_hit], use.names = FALSE)

fires <- st_read(input("fires.gpkg"), "fires", quiet = TRUE)
in_fire_2017 <- lengths(st_intersects(sites, filter(fires, year == 2017))) > 0
in_fire_2018_25 <- lengths(st_intersects(sites, filter(fires, between(year, 2018, 2025)))) > 0
```

```{r}
#| label: sample-environmental-rasters
#| include: false
at_sites <- function(layer, cells = FALSE) {
  xy <- st_transform(sites, crs(layer)) %>% st_coordinates()
  terra::extract(layer, xy, cells = cells)
}
regional_climate <- at_sites(rast(input("climate.tif")), cells = TRUE)
dsm <- rast(input("copernicus_glo30.tif"))
# Keep surrounding source cells for slope at the edge of the study window.
terrain_bounds <- ext(vect(st_transform(study_area, crs(dsm))))
dsm <- crop(dsm, extend(terrain_bounds, 2 * res(dsm)[1]), snap = "out")
slope <- terrain(dsm, v = "slope", unit = "degrees", neighbors = 8)
terrain_values <- at_sites(c(dsm, slope))
dnbr <- at_sites(rast(input("fire_dnbr_2017.tif")))[[1]]
suitability <- at_sites(rast(input("fire_confidence_2017.tif")))[[1]]

management <- rast(input("forest_management_2015.tif"))
management_code <- at_sites(management)[[1]]
planted <- ifel(management == 31 | management == 32, 1, NA)
planted_cells <- as.polygons(planted, dissolve = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>% st_transform(3763) %>% st_geometry()
nearest <- st_nearest_feature(sites, planted_cells)
planted_m <- as.numeric(st_distance(st_geometry(sites), planted_cells[nearest],
                                    by_element = TRUE))
crop_edge <- as.polygons(management, extent = TRUE) %>% st_as_sf() %>%
  st_transform(3763) %>% st_boundary()
edge_m <- as.numeric(st_distance(sites, crop_edge))
```

```{r}
#| label: write-environment-table
#| include: false
environment <- sites %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(site_id = paste(x_m, y_m, sep = "_"), .before = 1) %>%
  mutate(cos_2018_code = land18$cover_code[land_row],
         cos_2018_label = land18$cover_name[land_row],
         chelsa_cell = regional_climate$cell, temp_mean_c = regional_climate$temp_c,
         precip_annual_mm = regional_climate$precip_mm, wind_speed_ms = regional_climate$wind_speed_ms,
         elevation_m = terrain_values[[1]],
         slope_deg = terrain_values[[2]], burned_perimeter_2017 = in_fire_2017,
         dnbr_2017 = dnbr, image_suitability_2017_pct = suitability,
         management_2015_code = management_code,
         planted_forest_2015_m = if_else(planted_m <= edge_m, planted_m, NA_real_),
         burned_perimeter_2018_2025 = in_fire_2018_25)
readr::write_csv(environment, "environment.csv", na = "")
```

Each row in `environment.csv` is one point on the 80 m grid. We used its climate, elevation, slope, land cover, fire and forest management data to find similar sites near and far from roads. Nearby points can share a climate cell.

## Result 1

```{r}
#| label: choose-2018-stands
#| include: false
source_stands <- read_sf(input("land_cover.gpkg"), "euc2018")
regular_roads <- read_sf(input("roads.gpkg"), "roads2018") %>% filter(group != "track")
eligible_cover <- function(code) substr(code, 1, 1) %in% as.character(2:6) & code != "5.1.1.6"
whole <- lengths(st_geometry(source_stands)) == 1 & lengths(st_within(source_stands, study_area)) == 1

# Find nearby old stands first, then use exact point-to-polygon distances.
sites_2018 <- environment %>%
  filter(eligible_cover(cos_2018_code), is.finite(planted_forest_2015_m),
         !burned_perimeter_2017 | (is.finite(dnbr_2017) & image_suitability_2017_pct > 0)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x_m", "y_m"), crs = 3763, remove = FALSE)
stand_geom <- st_geometry(source_stands)
site_geom <- st_geometry(sites_2018)
nearby <- st_intersects(st_buffer(stand_geom, 51), site_geom)
distances <- bind_rows(lapply(which(lengths(nearby) > 0), function(j) {
  i <- nearby[[j]]
  distance_m <- as.numeric(st_distance(site_geom[i], stand_geom[j]))
  tibble(i = i, j = j, forest_m = distance_m)
}))
nearest <- distances %>% group_by(i) %>% slice_min(forest_m, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>% filter(forest_m > 0, forest_m <= 50, whole[j])
pool <- sites_2018[nearest$i, ] %>%
  mutate(source_id = source_stands$source_id[nearest$j], forest_m = nearest$forest_m,
         planted = planted_forest_2015_m < 1e-6, site_row = row_number())
road_geom <- st_geometry(regular_roads)
road_index <- st_nearest_feature(pool, regular_roads)
pool$road_m <- as.numeric(st_length(st_nearest_points(st_geometry(pool), road_geom[road_index],
                                                      pairwise = TRUE)))
pool <- st_drop_geometry(pool)
keys <- c("source_id", "cos_2018_code", "burned_perimeter_2017", "planted")
near_sites <- pool %>% filter(road_m <= 100) %>% select(all_of(keys), a = site_row)
far_sites <- pool %>% filter(road_m > 500) %>% select(all_of(keys), b = site_row)
candidates <- sort(intersect(near_sites$source_id, far_sites$source_id))
links <- merge(near_sites, far_sites, by = keys)
within_limit <- function(x, limit) abs(x[links$a] - x[links$b]) <= limit
dx <- pool$x_m[links$a] - pool$x_m[links$b]
dy <- pool$y_m[links$a] - pool$y_m[links$b]
matched <- links %>%
  filter(dx^2 + dy^2 <= 1000^2, within_limit(pool$forest_m, 20),
         within_limit(pool$elevation_m, 30), within_limit(pool$slope_deg, 5),
         within_limit(pool$temp_mean_c, 0.5), within_limit(pool$precip_annual_mm, 50),
         within_limit(pool$wind_speed_ms, 0.5), within_limit(pool$planted_forest_2015_m, 100),
         !burned_perimeter_2017 | within_limit(pool$dnbr_2017, 0.1))
focus_stands <- source_stands %>% filter(source_id %in% matched$source_id) %>%
  arrange(source_id) %>% mutate(number = match(source_id, candidates))
```

```{r}
#| label: compare-outside-belts
#| include: false
road_buffer <- function(m) st_union(st_buffer(road_geom, m))
road100 <- road_buffer(100)
road500 <- road_buffer(500)
eligible_land <- land18 %>% filter(eligible_cover(cover_code)) %>% st_geometry()
empty_polygon <- st_sfc(st_polygon(), crs = 3763)
polygon_union <- function(g) {
  g <- g[!st_is_empty(g) & st_dimension(g, NA_if_empty = FALSE) == 2]
  if (!length(g)) return(empty_polygon)
  st_union(suppressWarnings(st_collection_extract(g, "POLYGON")))
}
clip_area <- function(x, y) {
  hits <- st_intersects(x, y)[[1]]
  if (!length(hits)) return(empty_polygon)
  polygon_union(suppressWarnings(st_intersection(x, y[hits])))
}
subtract_area <- function(x, y) polygon_union(st_difference(x, y))
sides <- c("near", "middle", "far")
belt_for_stand <- function(k) {
  # Use only the exterior ring, so that interior clearings do not enter the belt.
  outer <- st_sfc(st_polygon(list(st_geometry(focus_stands)[[k]][[1]][[1]])), crs = 3763)
  belt <- subtract_area(clip_area(st_buffer(outer, 50), study_area), outer)
  land <- clip_area(belt, eligible_land)
  within500 <- clip_area(land, road500)
  near <- clip_area(within500, road100)
  zones <- c(near, subtract_area(within500, near), subtract_area(land, within500))
  st_sf(source_id = focus_stands$source_id[k], road = sides,
        geometry = st_cast(zones, "MULTIPOLYGON", warn = FALSE))
}
belt_zones <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(focus_stands)), belt_for_stand))
zone_geom <- st_geometry(belt_zones)
gains <- lapply(seq_along(zone_geom), function(i) {
  g <- clip_area(zone_geom[i], forest25)
  if (as.numeric(st_area(g)) < 1e-4) g <- empty_polygon
  st_cast(g, "MULTIPOLYGON", warn = FALSE)
})
belt_gains <- st_set_geometry(belt_zones, do.call(c, gains))
stand_areas <- st_drop_geometry(belt_zones) %>%
  mutate(eligible_ha = areas_ha(belt_zones), gain_ha = areas_ha(belt_gains),
         pct = 100 * gain_ha / eligible_ha)
belt_rates <- stand_areas %>% group_by(source_id) %>%
  summarise(near_pct = pct[road == "near"], far_pct = pct[road == "far"],
            difference_pp = near_pct - far_pct, .groups = "drop")

# Dissolve shared belts before counting areas or counting distinct changed patches.
zone_union <- belt_zones %>% group_by(road) %>% summarise(.groups = "drop")
gain_union <- belt_gains %>% group_by(road) %>% summarise(.groups = "drop")
side_areas <- tibble(road = sides,
  eligible_ha = areas_ha(zone_union)[match(sides, zone_union$road)],
  gain_ha = areas_ha(gain_union)[match(sides, gain_union$road)]) %>%
  mutate(gain_share_pct = 100 * gain_ha / sum(gain_ha), gain_pct = 100 * gain_ha / eligible_ha)
parts <- changes %>% filter(cover == "Gained") %>% st_geometry() %>%
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON", warn = FALSE) %>% st_cast("POLYGON", warn = FALSE)
patches <- st_sf(patch = seq_along(parts), geometry = parts)
overlap <- suppressWarnings(st_intersection(patches, zone_union)) %>%
  mutate(m2 = as.numeric(st_area(.))) %>% st_drop_geometry()
by_patch <- overlap %>% group_by(patch) %>%
  summarise(total_m2 = sum(m2), near = any(road == "near" & m2 > 1),
            middle = any(road == "middle" & m2 > 1), far = any(road == "far" & m2 > 1),
            .groups = "drop") %>% filter(total_m2 > 1)
patch_counts <- by_patch %>%
  summarise(total = n(), near_only = sum(near & !middle & !far),
            near_middle = sum(near & middle), outside_near = sum(!near), near = sum(near))
```

```{r}
#| label: compare-environments
#| include: false
# Assign each 20 m cell its nearest original environmental value.
# The smaller cells allow area weighting where forest boundaries cross a grid cell.
grid20 <- rast(xmin = 20 * floor(bounds["xmin"] / 20), xmax = 20 * ceiling(bounds["xmax"] / 20),
               ymin = 20 * floor(bounds["ymin"] / 20), ymax = 20 * ceiling(bounds["ymax"] / 20),
               resolution = 20, crs = "EPSG:3763")
align20 <- function(layer) terra::project(layer, grid20, method = "near")
env_grid <- c(align20(c(dsm, slope)), align20(rast(input("climate.tif"))), align20(management),
              rasterize(vect(filter(fires, year == 2017)), grid20, field = 1, background = 0),
              align20(rast(input("fire_dnbr_2017.tif"))),
              align20(rast(input("fire_confidence_2017.tif"))))
names(env_grid) <- c("elevation", "slope", "temperature", "rain", "wind", "management",
                     "burned", "severity", "quality")
env_grid <- writeRaster(env_grid, tempfile(fileext = ".tif"), datatype = "FLT4S")

# Give eligible land and mapped gain the same cover classes and forest-edge bands.
original_cover <- land18 %>% filter(eligible_cover(cover_code)) %>% select(cover_code)
edge25 <- source_stands %>% filter(source_id %in% focus_stands$source_id) %>%
  select(source_id) %>% st_buffer(25, nQuadSegs = 48)
split_edge_band <- function(one_stand) {
  inside25 <- st_geometry(edge25[edge25$source_id == one_stand$source_id[1], ])
  bind_rows(st_intersection(one_stand, inside25) %>% mutate(edge_band = "0-25"),
            st_difference(one_stand, inside25) %>% mutate(edge_band = "25-50"))
}
belt_parts <- bind_rows(eligible = select(belt_zones, source_id, road),
                        gain = select(belt_gains, source_id, road), .id = "measure") %>%
  filter(road %in% c("near", "far"), !st_is_empty(.)) %>%
  st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON", warn = FALSE) %>% st_cast("POLYGON", warn = FALSE) %>%
  st_intersection(original_cover) %>% st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>%
  filter(as.numeric(st_area(.)) > 1e-6)
belt_parts <- bind_rows(lapply(split(belt_parts, belt_parts$source_id), split_edge_band)) %>%
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>% filter(as.numeric(st_area(.)) > 1e-6)

# Weight each polygon by the fraction of each 0.04 ha grid cell that it covers.
cell_areas <- function(rows) {
  pieces <- belt_parts[rows, ]
  hit <- terra::extract(env_grid[[1]], vect(pieces), exact = TRUE, cells = TRUE)
  st_drop_geometry(pieces)[hit$ID, ] %>% mutate(cell = hit$cell, ha = 0.04 * hit$fraction)
}
rows <- seq_len(nrow(belt_parts))
area_rows <- bind_rows(lapply(split(rows, (rows - 1L) %/% 120L), cell_areas))
cell_ids <- unique(area_rows$cell)
classes <- terra::extract(env_grid, cell_ids) %>%
  mutate(cell = cell_ids) %>%
  filter(!is.na(management), burned == 0 | quality > 0) %>%
  transmute(cell, planted_class = management %in% c(31, 32), burned,
            severity_band = if_else(burned == 0, 0, floor(severity / 0.10)),
            temp_band = floor(temperature / 0.5), rain_band = floor(rain / 50),
            wind_band = floor(wind / 0.5), elev_band = floor(elevation / 30),
            slope_band = floor(slope / 5)) %>% filter(complete.cases(.))
by_side <- inner_join(area_rows, classes, by = "cell") %>%
  group_by(source_id, cover_code, edge_band, planted_class, burned, severity_band,
           temp_band, rain_band, wind_band, elev_band, slope_band, road) %>%
  summarise(eligible_ha = sum(ha[measure == "eligible"]), gain_ha = sum(ha[measure == "gain"]),
            .groups = "drop") %>% filter(eligible_ha > 1e-6)

# Compare only classes present on both sides of the same forest.
shared <- inner_join(filter(by_side, road == "near") %>% select(-road),
                     filter(by_side, road == "far") %>% select(-road),
                     by = c("source_id", "cover_code", "edge_band", "planted_class", "burned",
                            "severity_band", "temp_band", "rain_band", "wind_band", "elev_band",
                            "slope_band"), suffix = c("_near", "_far")) %>%
  mutate(weight = pmin(eligible_ha_near, eligible_ha_far))
env_stands <- shared %>% group_by(source_id) %>%
  summarise(overlap_ha = sum(weight),
            near_pct = 100 * weighted.mean(gain_ha_near / eligible_ha_near, weight),
            far_pct = 100 * weighted.mean(gain_ha_far / eligible_ha_far, weight), .groups = "drop")
env_result <- env_stands %>% summarise(stands = n(), overlap_ha = sum(overlap_ha),
  near_pct = mean(near_pct), far_pct = mean(far_pct), difference_pp = near_pct - far_pct)
```

On the 80 m grid, `r length(candidates)` eucalyptus stands had sites both near a road (up to 100 m) and far from a road (over 500 m). We kept the `r nrow(focus_stands)` stands where the near and far sites had similar conditions. We looked at a strip of land up to 50 m outside each stand’s 2018 edge and left out clearings inside the stand. Purple shows where the map changed from another land cover in 2018 to eucalyptus in 2025.

```{r}
#| label: perimeter-map
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 6.5
#| fig-height: 3.85
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-alt: "Stand 35 and its enlarged southern edge. Magenta shows mapped eucalypt gains inside the 50 m belt outside the 2018 stand."

stand35 <- focus_stands %>% filter(source_id == 738157)
zones35 <- belt_zones %>% filter(source_id == 738157)
gains35 <- belt_gains %>% filter(source_id == 738157)
belt_colour <- c(near = "#F3BA73", middle = "#D4D1C8", far = "#83B7D6")
forest_colour <- "#A5C5B4"
gain_colour <- "#A12669"
road_colour <- "#667674"

# Coordinates in Portugal's national grid (EPSG:3763), in metres.
overview <- c(-11208, 54174, -4461, 61105)
detail <- c(-8480, 55447.58, -7400, 56362.42)
draw_edge <- function(bounds, roads, scale_m, heading) {
  x <- bounds[c(1, 3)]
  y <- bounds[c(2, 4)]
  par(mar = c(0.15, 0.15, 1.3, 0.15))
  plot.new()
  plot.window(x, y, asp = 1, xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
  rect(x[1], y[1], x[2], y[2], col = "#F9F7F1", border = NA)
  clip(x[1], x[2], y[1], y[2])
  plot(st_geometry(stand35), add = TRUE, col = forest_colour, border = "#658478", lwd = 0.35)
  plot(st_geometry(zones35), add = TRUE, col = belt_colour[as.character(zones35$road)], border = NA)
  plot(st_geometry(gains35), add = TRUE, col = gain_colour, border = NA)
  box <- st_bbox(c(xmin = x[1], ymin = y[1], xmax = x[2], ymax = y[2]), crs = st_crs(stand35))
  roads <- roads[st_as_sfc(box), ]
  plot(st_geometry(roads), add = TRUE, col = road_colour, lwd = 0.55)
  rect(x[1], y[1], x[2], y[2], border = "#A8B5AF", lwd = 0.6)
  mtext(heading, side = 3, adj = 0, line = 0.25, cex = 0.88, font = 2)
  nx <- x[2] - 0.045 * diff(x)
  text(nx, y[2] - 0.04 * diff(y), "N", font = 2, cex = 0.68)
  arrows(nx, y[2] - 0.12 * diff(y), nx, y[2] - 0.065 * diff(y), length = 0.04)
  sx <- x[1] + 0.045 * diff(x)
  sy <- y[1] + 0.06 * diff(y)
  rect(sx - 0.015 * diff(x), sy - 0.018 * diff(y),
       sx + scale_m + 0.015 * diff(x), sy + 0.065 * diff(y), col = "#F9F7F1", border = NA)
  segments(sx, sy, sx + scale_m, sy, lwd = 1.5)
  text(sx + scale_m / 2, sy + 0.033 * diff(y), paste(scale_m, "m"), cex = 0.68)
}

layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3, 3), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
       widths = c(550, 667), heights = c(1, 0.17))
draw_edge(overview, filter(regular_roads, group == "major"), 1000, "Stand 35 (major roads)")
rect(detail[1], detail[2], detail[3], detail[4], border = "#272F37", lwd = 1.25)
draw_edge(detail, regular_roads, 200, "Boxed area (major and local roads)")

par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot.new()
legend("center", ncol = 3, bty = "n", cex = 0.79, x.intersp = 0.45, y.intersp = 1.15,
       legend = c("2018 eucalypt stand", "Mapped gain by 2025", "Near road (0-100 m)",
                  "Middle (>100 to 500 m)", "Far from road (>500 m)", "2018 road"),
       col = c(forest_colour, gain_colour, belt_colour[c("near", "middle", "far")], road_colour),
       pch = c(rep(15, 5), NA), lty = c(rep(0, 5), 1), lwd = 1.3, pt.cex = 1.4)
```

*Around stand 35, the map showed new eucalyptus cover on `r sprintf("%.2f", belt_rates$near_pct[belt_rates$source_id == 738157])`% of the land we compared near roads and `r sprintf("%.2f", belt_rates$far_pct[belt_rates$source_id == 738157])`% far from roads.*

Across all `r nrow(focus_stands)` stands, we found **`r sprintf("%.2f", sum(side_areas$gain_ha))` ha** of new eucalyptus cover in the strips. Within these strips, **`r patch_counts$near` of the `r patch_counts$total` new patches** reached land within 100 m of a road. The other `r patch_counts$outside_near` stayed farther away. We counted land shared by two stands once.

```{r}
#| label: final-road-distance-table
#| echo: false
distance_labels <- c(near = "Up to 100 m", middle = "Over 100 to 500 m", far = "Over 500 m")
side_areas %>%
  transmute("Road distance" = unname(distance_labels[road]),
            "Land compared (ha)" = sprintf("%.2f", eligible_ha), "Gain (ha)" = sprintf("%.2f", gain_ha),
            "Share of total gain" = sprintf("%.1f%%", gain_share_pct),
            "Land with gain" = sprintf("%.2f%%", gain_pct)) %>%
  knitr::kable(format = "pipe", align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r"))
```

In `r env_result$stands` stands we could compare near and far land with similar cover, fire history, plantation status, terrain, climate and distance from the forest edge. Within each group of similar land, we gave both sides the weight of the smaller area. This gave `r sprintf("%.2f", env_result$overlap_ha)` ha per side in total. We then gave each stand equal weight. New eucalyptus cover averaged **`r sprintf("%.2f", env_result$near_pct)`% near roads** and **`r sprintf("%.2f", env_result$far_pct)`% far from roads**. Only `r sum(env_stands$near_pct > 0 | env_stands$far_pct > 0)` stands showed any gain on this land. This gives little support for the idea that roads help eucalyptus spread. The maps cannot tell us whether the trees were planted or grew naturally.

## Data sources

- **Land cover and the pilot road.** Direção-Geral do Território (DGT), COS Series 2, [2018 v4](https://ogcapi.dgterritorio.gov.pt/collections/cos2018v4) and [2025 v1](https://ogcapi.dgterritorio.gov.pt/collections/cos2025v1). The forest maps use eucalyptus class 5.1.1.6. [DGT, CC BY 4.0](https://www.dgterritorio.gov.pt/dados-abertos)
- **Regional roads.** We used the 1 January 2018 road network in `roads.gpkg` and excluded tracks. © OpenStreetMap contributors. [Geofabrik Portugal archive](https://download.geofabrik.de/europe/portugal.html) · [ODbL 1.0](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright)
- **Pilot aerial photos.** DGT imagery from 2018 and 2025, exported at 2 m for area B. [DGT orthophotos, CC BY 4.0](https://www.dgterritorio.gov.pt/atividades/cartografia/cartografia-topografica/ortofotos/ortofotos-digitais)
- **Pilot climate.** WorldClim v2.1, temperature and rainfall averages for 1970–2000. [WorldClim](https://www.worldclim.org/data/worldclim21.html) · [Fick and Hijmans (2017)](https://doi.org/10.1002/joc.5086)
- **Regional climate.** CHELSA v2.1, temperature, rainfall and mean near-surface wind speed for 1981–2010. [CHELSA](https://www.chelsa-climate.org/datasets/chelsa_bioclim) · [BIOCLIM+ data, CC0](https://doi.org/10.16904/envidat.332)
- **Elevation and slope.** Copernicus DEM GLO-30, tile N40/W009. [Product and licence](https://dataspace.copernicus.eu/explore-data/data-collections/copernicus-contributing-missions/collections-description/COP-DEM)
- **Fire.** ICNF, *Áreas ardidas*, 2017–2025, retrieved 5 November 2026. [Fire perimeters](https://sigservices.icnf.pt/server/rest/services/BDG/areas_ardidas/FeatureServer) · [ICNF terms](https://geocatalogo.icnf.pt/dados/condicoes_utilizacao.pdf). The 2017 burn severity and image quality layers come from Jahanianfard et al. [Portuguese Burn Severity Atlas v2, CC BY 4.0](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15188051)
- **Forest management.** Lesiv et al., global forest management map for 2015, v3.2. [Data, CC BY 4.0](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.5115984)
